title: SEED-L06 approved loan-status ordinal read-back
_note: Parity vector transcribing the approved loan-status read-back returned on the SEED-L06 approval command. request.status.stored_value=200 is the capture changes.status block's "id":200, the persisted m_loan.loan_status_id; expect.status_code="loanStatusType.approved" is that block's "code"; expect.status_stored_value=200 is the stored value the decoded enum must round-trip to — Fineract stores APPROVED as 200, not as the contiguous iota ordinal 2. Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: request.status.stored_value and expect.status_code/status_stored_value are transcribed from the changes.status block of the committed capture loan-L06-approve-raw.json; capture_case_id names the resourceExternalId of the observed loan.
